inputs.text: [curious] IK… thee… oh… SOR… us. "Ichthys," in Greek, means fish. [serious] And "saurus," lizard.
[happily] That's the one. He lived one hundred ninety million years ago, [amazed] in the shallow seas of Europe.
[curious] A lizard that looks like a fish, does that really happen?
[confident] It did, yes — but he wasn't a fish at all. [serious] He was a real reptile, shaped that way just to swim well.
